changelog: AC, solar and output power now read as unavailable instead of a nonsense figure such as 65534 W when the device has no reading for that channel, and the battery ring no longer turns one into a time estimate like "0h1m remaining". Battery power is left out too whenever one of those channels is missing, rather than being computed from a placeholder.

Device Info shows your battery's own serial number, or nothing at all when the platform has not reported one. It used to fall back to a fixed placeholder, so two batteries could both show the same serial.

Adding a device can now read the barcode on units whose label carries one instead of a QR code. The scanner only ever looked for QR codes, so owners of those units had nothing to point the camera at. QR codes scan exactly as before.

A battery at 100% now reads Full on the ring. It used to show "0h0m to full", which looks like an estimate that has got stuck — especially on a unit that sits at 100% and keeps drawing charge. A full battery being drawn down still shows how long it has left.

Smart Schedule opens and accepts changes again. The schedule endpoints answer some sessions with a token timeout even though the sign-in is perfectly valid; the app treated that as the session running out, signed you back to the login screen, and showed "Token missing" as the reason the schedule would not turn on. Those endpoints can no longer end a session, and the screen no longer blocks on their answer.
